name: Nightmare
source:
A mysterious girl dressed in a witch outfit.

[spoiler]In reality, she's the ghost of [url=/c5244]Yoru[/url]'s younger self, that she summoned as an astral projection. Her purpose is to call upon the [url=/c12530]Ghost Child[/url] and have him exact revenge on the town in Yoru's place.[/spoiler]
translation:
A mysterious girl dressed in a witch outfit.

[spoiler]In reality, she's the ghost of [url=/c5244]Yoru[/url]'s younger self, that she summoned as an astral projection. Her purpose is to call upon the [url=/c12530]Ghost Child[/url] and have him exact revenge on the town in Yoru's place.[/spoiler]
